title: Systems of Linear Equations: Elimination, Substitution and Word Problems
seo_title: Algebra 1 Systems of Equations Worksheets: Elimination, Substitution and Word Problems (Free, Answer Key)
standard_text: Solve systems of linear equations exactly and approximately (e.g., with graphs), focusing on pairs of linear equations in two variables.
meta_desc: Free Algebra 1 systems of equations worksheets (A-REI.C.6): elimination by adding or subtracting, multiplying one or both equations, substitution, and word problems with tickets, coins, mixtures and rates. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: Eliminate one variable, solve for the other, then substitute back.
key_sub: Same signs: subtract. Different signs: add. Check the answer in both equations.
body_html:
How it works

A system of linear equations is two equations that must be true at the same time. The solution is the one pair of values (x, y) that works in both. It is where the two lines cross.

Elimination: make one letter have the same number in front in both equations. If the signs are different, add. If the signs are the same, subtract. Substitution: if one equation says y = …, put that into the other equation.

Example

Solve 3x + y = 11 and x − y = 1.

Signs differ, so add: 4x = 12, x = 3.

3 − y = 1, so y = 2.

Answer: x = 3, y = 2

Example

Solve 2x + 3y = 12 and x + y = 5.

Multiply the second by 2: 2x + 2y = 10.

Subtract: y = 2, then x = 3.

Answer: x = 3, y = 2

Example

Solve y = 2x and x + y = 9.

x + 2x = 9, so x = 3.

y = 2 × 3 = 6.

Answer: x = 3, y = 6

Common mistakes

  • Adding when you should subtract. Same signs: subtract. Different signs: add.
  • Multiplying only one side of an equation. Multiply every term.
  • Finding x and stopping. You must find y as well.
  • Swapping the values of x and y. Check your answer in both equations.

faq.q: What is a system of linear equations?
faq.a: Two linear equations with the same two variables. The solution is the pair of values that makes both equations true.

faq.q: Do I add or subtract the equations?
faq.a: Look at the letter you want to remove. If its signs are the same, subtract. If they are different, add.
When one equation already says y = … or x = …. Put that expression into the other equation.

faq.q: How can a system have no solution or infinitely many?
faq.a: Each equation is a line. Parallel lines never meet (no solution); the same line meets everywhere (infinitely many solutions).

items.q: A school play sold 300 tickets. Adult tickets cost $12 and student tickets cost $7. Ticket sales were $2,850. How many adult tickets were sold?
items.e: a + s = 300 and 12a + 7s = 2,850. Multiply the first by 7: 7a + 7s = 2,100. Subtract: 5a = 750, so a = 150.

items.q: Maya has 30 coins, all dimes and quarters, worth $5.40. How many quarters does she have?
items.e: d + q = 30 and 10d + 25q = 540. Multiply the first by 10 and subtract: 15q = 240, so q = 16.

items.q: A chemist mixes a 10% acid solution with a 40% acid solution to make 30 L of a 20% solution. How many liters of the 10% solution are used?
items.e: a + b = 30 and 0.1a + 0.4b = 6. Multiply the first by 0.1 and subtract: 0.3b = 3, so b = 10 and a = 20 L.

items.q: A coffee shop mixes beans that cost $8 per pound with beans that cost $14 per pound to make 60 lb worth $10 per pound. How many pounds of $8 beans are used?
A boat goes 36 miles downstream in 2 hours and 36 miles back upstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the current?
items.e: b + c = 18 and b − c = 12. Subtract: 2c = 6, so c = 3 mph (and the boat goes 15 mph).

items.q: Gym A charges $50 to join and $30 a month. Gym B charges $20 to join and $35 a month. After how many months do they cost the same?
The sum of two numbers is 47 and their difference is 13. What is the smaller number?
items.e: Add: 2x = 60, so x = 30 and the smaller number is 17.

items.q: A farm has chickens and goats: 40 heads and 110 legs. How many goats are there?
items.e: c + g = 40 and 2c + 4g = 110. Double the first and subtract: 2g = 30, so g = 15.

items.q: 2 burgers and 3 drinks cost $18.50. 4 burgers and 1 drink cost $24.50. How much is one burger?
items.e: Double the first: 4b + 6d = 37. Subtract the second: 5d = 12.50, so d = 2.50 and b = $5.50.

items.q: A rectangle's perimeter is 54 ft. Its length is 3 ft less than twice its width. What is its length?
How many solutions does the system 2x − y = 4 and 4x − 2y = 8 have?
items.e: The second equation is the first times 2, so they are the same line: infinitely many.

items.q: How many solutions does the system y = 3x + 2 and y = 3x − 5 have?
items.e: Same slope, different intercepts: the lines are parallel, so there is no solution.

items.q: Which value of k makes the system x + 2y = 6 and 3x + ky = 10 have no solution?
items.e: For parallel lines the coefficients must be in the same ratio: k = 2 × 3 = 6 (and 10 ≠ 18).

items.q: A phone plan charges a monthly fee plus a cost per GB. 3 GB costs $41 and 7 GB costs $61. What is the monthly fee?
items.e: 4 more GB cost $20, so 1 GB costs $5. Fee = 41 − 15 = $26.

items.q: At a fair, 3 hot dogs and 2 lemonades cost $16. 2 hot dogs and 4 lemonades cost $16. How much is a lemonade?
items.e: Multiply the first by 2: 6h + 4l = 32. Subtract the second: 4h = 16, so h = 4 and l = $2.

items.q: Which ordered pair is the solution of y = −x + 5 and y = 2x − 4?
A plane flies 1,200 miles with the wind in 3 hours and back against the wind in 4 hours. What is its speed in still air?
Liam invests $5,000, part at 3% and part at 5% simple interest. He earns $190 in a year. How much is at 5%?
items.e: a + b = 5,000 and 0.03a + 0.05b = 190. Multiply the first by 0.03 and subtract: 0.02b = 40, so b = $2,000.

items.q: Which method is quickest for y = 4x − 1 and 3x + 2y = 20?
items.e: y is already alone, so put 4x − 1 in for y: substitution. (The solution is (2, 7).)

items.q: Ethan solves a system and gets x = 2, y = 5. How can he check?
items.e: The pair must make both equations true.
